title: Apple’s AI Deals And India Shift Reframe Growth And Supply Chain
text: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is acquiring AI audio startup Q.ai in a US$2b deal, expanding its capabilities in voice and sound-focused artificial intelligence. The company has agreed a new multi year partnership with Google to bring Gemini AI into Siri and its Foundation models. India has introduced a policy allowing Apple to supply manufacturing equipment tax free to local partners, supporting its production build out in the country.
